accounting_amendment.cash: recomputed from actual integer actions, no relaxed guards or solver tolerances
accounting_amendment.selected_actions: unchanged original solver extraction; independent compilation verifies equality

action_comparison: pi0 diagnostic state bank at ALL t; adjacent policies solved on identical begun state
bucket_boundary: R<=c33 surplus; c33<R<=c67 balanced; R>c67 scarce; ties retained and reported

convergence.note: descriptive joint criteria, not a convergence theorem

effectiveness.state_aliasing_evidence: positive formal/diagnostic paired gains, correct Holm support in CA or W40, W80 noninferiority, variance corroboration and adequate support; unmet threshold is inconclusive
effectiveness.within_variance: construction decomposition descriptive; independent diagnostic target variance corroboration required, not automatic train-group variance decrease

fallback: ANY active nonterminal interpolation source corner count<10 OR q>K: use SAME base table at query; record all calls/reasons
future_sampling: own scenario only; no shared donor; same CRN scenario across iterations

interpolation.counterfactual_max_q: 2K: retained nonqueried resources plus inserted queried supply
interpolation.q: piecewise linear at integer q; endpoint constant beyond measured K
interpolation.time: piecewise linear; endpoint constant below first node

online_bucket: current observation hub bucket prices future release slot; no candidate-dependent post-state
parent: M0 for BOTH base and bucket targets
placement_rule: sum eligible CFS outbound WGT_FACTOR by hub; K3 top3; K8 one-per-hub plus top3; tie by hub ID; no fleet RNG
pressure: Bready + (known booked near-ready + construction expected unbooked near-ready) over idle+known near incoming+1
scientific_scope: one M0 parent policy improvement, no bucket PI, no damping, no ACTION correction, no RL
state_sampling: each iteration recollect current parent-policy on-policy states; fixed seed/time/hub grid
target_hub_sampling: ALL five hubs at the SAME seven A time nodes, BOTH base and bucket; 60 independent construction scenarios per raw tuq before splitting into b

terminal.commitments: full physical cooldown; no new controls

unit: Bload and Dnear in passenger/capacity vehicle equivalents; supply in vehicles
